title: Replacing the prime component of formal glueing data
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $t\geq0$, and $f:\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\to R$. Let $Y$ be a formal glueing datum [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], $Q$ an $S$-module and $h:Q\to Y^{\prime}$ an $S$-linear map. Suppose every localized map $h_{f_i}$ is bijective [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Then there exist a glueing datum $X$, a morphism $a:X\to Y$ and an $S$-linear isomorphism $e:X^{\prime}\to Q$ such that the prime component of $a$ equals $h\circ e$, and every chart component of $a$ is bijective. No flatness or quotient assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Keep the chart modules and overlap equivalences of Y, replace its prime component by Q, and compose each comparison with the linear equivalence from localized h. The localized S-linearity of h (FormalGlueing.localMap_smul) and Y.alpha_smul give the S-linearity of the new comparison.

Interchange is natural with respect to h. Prove equality of the two paths by two applications of localization uniqueness and their equality on original numerators: each sends m to h(m) and interchanges the same denominators. Localization preserves composition. Precompose the old square with double-localized h and use naturality to obtain the new square. The cocycle is unchanged.

Take prime component h and identity chart components. Prime compatibility follows by the definition of the new comparison and scalar extension of identity; chart compatibility follows by localization of identity. Choose the identity equivalence e on Q. All chart components are bijective.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_replace_prime_to
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) {t : ℕ} (f : Fin t → R)
    (Y : Data.{u, v, max u v w} φ f) (Q : ModuleCat.{max u v w} S)
    (h : Q →ₗ[S] Y.M')
    (hloc : ∀ i : Fin t, Function.Bijective
      (localMap (f i) (restrictMap φ h))) :
    ∃ X : Data.{u, v, max u v w} φ f,
      ∃ (a : X ⟶ Y) (e : X.M' ≃ₗ[S] Q),
        a.prime = h.comp e.toLinearMap ∧
        ∀ i : Fin t, Function.Bijective (a.chart i)
